feeds.title: Jesus Film Project Blog
feeds.description: Read and share stories of how God's amazing love and power reach people through churches, organizations, Bible studies, technology, and more. The goal of the Jesus Film Project is to help share Jesus with everyone in his or her own heart language using media tools and movement-building strategies.

feeds.title: Movieguide News & Articles
feeds.description: Read more News on Movieguide. The Family and Christian Guide to Movie Reviews and Entertainment News. Movieguide reviews movies from a Christian perspective for families and works in Hollywood to redeem the media

feeds.title: Family Theater Blog
feeds.description: Family Theater Productions creates quirky, fun, & informative faith-based media for families around the world. Learn about our engaging & impactful media.

feeds.title: The Christian Film Review
feeds.description: We are based in the UK and our aim is to inspire and encourage people to find out about and watch Christian films. We hope that this website will help you to become more aware of the Christian movies out there, the alternatives that in this day in age are a light in the darkness of what society is promoting.

feeds.title: 1More Film Blog
feeds.description: Find Blog Posts on Films, Publication, Reviews, and Interviews on the 1More Film Blog. Ken is a Professor of English at Campbell University. He is the editor of and a contributor to Faith and Spirituality in Masters of World Cinema. Ken has written numerous film reviews at Christianity Today Movies and The Gospel Coalition.

feeds.title: Bible Films Blog
feeds.description: Hi, and welcome to the Bible Films Blog - the largest source of information about Bible Films on the internet. For those interested in Bible films, Jesus films & films exploring biblical narratives. Read reviews, updates, comments, and analyses on Bible Films and Jesus Films past, present, and future.

feeds.title: Decent Films
feeds.description: Steven D. Greydanus, who often goes by SDG, has been writing about film since 2000 when he created Decent Films. Since then, he's written regularly for a number of outlets including the National Catholic Register, Catholic Digest, Crux, Christianity Today, and Catholic World Report. Other bylines include Slate, Bright Wall/Dark Room, and Our Sunday Visitor.

feeds.title: Warhorn Media
feeds.description: Podcasts and articles on Christian faith, culture, and pop culture. Biblical sanity for an insane world. Welcome to the reformation. Warhorn Media wants to do everything in our power to take the Word of God to the people.

feeds.title: Christian Film Blog
feeds.description: Christian Film Blog views cinema as a powerful mechanism to glorify God, unite and edify the Body and spread the Gospel of Jesus Christ to those outside the Church. Toward those ends, and with the help of the Holy Spirit, our aim is to be the go-to source for news and information about the Christian movie and television business.

feeds.title: Brett McCracken Blog
feeds.description: The author, Brett McCracken is a writer, journalist, film critic, pastor who is Seeking God and Celebrating Good.
